## EMST role: Natural resource and environmental programme manager (state variant, senior/lead level; P1)

*Match:* `skos:relatedMatch`, confidence 0.3, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R13-resource-program-manager/state:2686`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (agent draft)**

- Formulate, justify and execute public budgets across appropriations cycles — senior L3, lead L4 *(distinguishing)*
- Brief decision-makers and elected officials for authoritative decisions — senior L3, lead L4
- Govern enterprise environmental data and AI portfolios — lead L4
- Elicit, document and transfer tacit and institutional knowledge before people leave — senior L3, lead L3
- Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality — senior L3, lead L3
- Design and administer cross-jurisdictional stewardship agreements — senior L3, lead L4
- Assess the durability and reversal risk of policy choices and time actions to policy windows — senior L3, lead L4
- Administer contracts, grants and intergovernmental agreements — senior L3, lead L4
- Prepare and revise management plans for publicly held lands — senior L3, lead L4
- Design developmental work experiences that preserve the formation of professional judgment — senior L3, lead L4
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — senior L2, lead L3
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — senior L2, lead L3
- Design human-in-the-loop review for AI-assisted environmental workflows — lead L3
- Specify, evaluate and accept AI and analytics services in procurement — senior L3, lead L3
- Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards — senior L3, lead L4
- Develop proposals and grant applications for environmental work — senior L3, lead L3
- Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance — senior L3, lead L3
- Apply systems thinking across ecological, institutional and technical systems — senior L3, lead L3
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — senior L3, lead L4
- Navigate legislative and governing-body processes for environmental programs — senior L3, lead L4

**Main tasks at this level (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- Prepare a program budget request and justification linking each funding increment to outputs and outcomes the budget office can verify — 10.2% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Reconcile program obligations and expenditures against appropriations, agreements and fee accounts each month, flagging any use outside purpose or period — 6.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Write a decision memo for an accountable official, stating the decision required, options, evidence, risks and a recommendation within two pages — 6.7% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Coordinate an interdisciplinary team drafting a forest, range or refuge management plan, assigning plan components and reconciling conflicting resource objectives — 6.7% *(critical)*
- Prepare a continuing-resolution and funding-lapse contingency plan, ranking program activities by legal requirement and consequence of delay — 3.4% *(critical)*
- Brief appropriations staff or a governing board on a program budget request, answering questions with figures traceable to the justification — 3.4%
- Assess the reversal risk of a program's key instruments, recording the evidence, the likely triggers and a contingency for each high-risk instrument — 3.4%
- Brief a decision-maker orally on a pending decision under time pressure, answering questions and stating where the evidence is uncertain — 3.4% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Prepare a staff report for a governing body's public meeting, stating findings, options and the legal basis for each recommended action — 3.4%
- Track bills, ordinances and appropriations measures affecting the program, summarizing each relevant provision's effect on program operations — 3.4% *(needed at entry)*
- Write a dated change notice explaining what a new rule, guidance or court decision changes for staff, its effective dates and the work in progress it affects — 3.4% *(needed at entry)*
- Draft a memorandum of understanding or interagency agreement that assigns shared responsibilities, resources and decision rights for a joint program — 3.4%
